items.lede: The Meta-owned social media platform now lets creators attach up to 30 affiliate links per Reel to make money from Amazon more easily.
items.title: Instagram Is Bringing Amazon Affiliate Links Directly to Reels and Posts

items.lede: The app will become even more of a shopping mall, just in time for Black Friday.
items.title: Instagram will let creators add Amazon affiliate links directly to their posts and Reels

items.lede: While creators have long shared Amazon affiliate links through stories, DMs, and their bios, the new integration brings them to new parts of the app.
items.title: Instagram now lets creators add Amazon affiliate links in reels and feed posts
